name: friends-premier-league
description: Fantasy Premier League analytics dashboard for Friends Premier League Cup

scripts.build: tsc && cp index.html dist/ && mkdir -p dist/css dist/data/cache dist/images && cp css/style.css dist/css/ && cp data/cache/*.json dist/data/cache/ && (cp images/* dist/images/ 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.start: npm run build && npx http-server dist -p 3000 -o
scripts.dev: npm run build:watch & npx http-server dist -p 3000
